entities.name: write-prd skill
entities.description: skills/write-prd/SKILL.md + commands/write-prd.md - converts a confirmed alignment record into a 12-heading destination document; carries UNKNOWN/HITL/RESEARCH forward and forbids code, module paths, endpoints, estimates, and issue-generation authorization

entities.name: destination document
entities.description: Phase-boundary artifact: problem, users, solution, observable stories, checkable acceptance criteria, data behavior, contracts, module map, tests, security constraints, non-goals, rejected decisions, risks

entities.name: authored-vs-generated evidence gap
entities.description: A gate worded 'generated fixtures' is not satisfied by hand-authored walkthroughs; authored fixtures prove the artifact contract is satisfiable and checkable, not that an agent reliably produces it
